text:
Maya: FYI change window tonight 23:30 PT for /api/v1/generate - blue->green swap (A -> A-v2). Plan is conservative: micro-steps, QA signoff after step 2, and a hard rollback gate.

Jon: Plan outline: 3% -> 10% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. 8m observation windows. QA will run golden prompts and regression checks after 10% and 60%.

Priya: Preflight: confirm model warm replicas, health probes green, and no OOMs in last 2h. I see 10 warm replicas in us-west2. Cookie drain TTL is 120s.

Sam: Monitoring thresholds: p95 latency > 300ms for 8m OR error ratio (5xx) > 1% absolute increase => rollback. Also watch token-cost drift > 12% per-token. If cost drift happens, we'll pause and run costed sample set.

Maya: Rollback commands (lbctl):```bash
# stop shift and pin back
lbctl set-traffic --route /api/v1/generate --from-version A-v2 --to-version A --percent 100 --force --note "emergency rollback"
# quarantine failing version
lbctl annotate-version --service generate --version A-v2 --annotation quarantined=true
```

ops-bot: Preflight check summary: warm_replicas=10, probe_status=OK, recent_oom=0, cookie_affinity=enabled. All checks: PASS.

Priya: QA steps: run `qa/golden-set` (automated), `qa/semantic-smoke` (manual spot check). If any semantic regression > 2 items, we stop.

Jon: Deploy steps I'll run interactively. Using lbctl we can also split by header X-Canary if we need fine-grained cohorts. We'll prefer cookie affinity but header-splitting available.

Sam: Probes/queries for grafana/datasource:
- p95 latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))`
- 5xx rate: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{code=~"5..",job="frontend"}[8m])) / sum(increase(http_requests_total{job="frontend"}[8m]))`
- token cost delta: custom metric `model_token_cost{version=~"A|A-v2"}` diffed over 10m

Maya: Release notes link: https://confluence.internal/releases/generate-A-v2 - contains known changes: improved latency on long context, slight beam tuning. QA please check output tone on system prompts.

Priya: If we detect subtle semantic drift (different entity handling), we will PAUSE shift and run rollback + label version as `needs-eval`.

Jon: Small example commands:```bash
# step -> 3%
lbctl split --route /api/v1/generate --weight A=97,A-v2=3 --note "micro-step 3%"
# verify
lbctl status --route /api/v1/generate --output json | jq '.split'
```

Sam: I'll create ephemeral alerts for the next 3 hours and add phone paging for severity>1 incidents. Also enabling request sampling (1%) to Sentry for traces.

Maya: QA signoff required before moving >25%. @Priya please post OK/FAIL after golden set.

ops-bot: Deployment ticket created: DP-1589. Link: https://tickets.internal/DP-1589. Change window: 23:30-00:30 PT.

Jon: I'll tag each step in the deploy ticket and paste smoke results here. Keep replies short (OK/WARN/FAIL). :thumbsup:

Priya: ACK. Starting automated golden set when 10% is live.

Sam: Note: if cookie-affinity causes uneven error exposure we may switch header-split and re-run step immediately. That switch will be communicated in this thread.

deploy-bot: job/gentle-sway-1749129999 queued at 1749129999. Manual confirmation required to run step 1.

Maya: All set. Going to run step 1 at 23:35 PT. If anyone is blocked, flag now. Otherwise we'll proceed and post results on each step.

Jon: Ready. I'll be monitoring logs and will post quick checks every step.

Priya: Ready. Will run QA after 10% and 60%.

Sam: Ready. Alerts good. Will escalate if thresholds breach.

Maya: Thanks team. Remember to keep trace samples and attach a short note to the deploy ticket for each status change.

Jon: Roger. Posting first smoke after step 1 in ~10m.
